questions.question: What is order quantity by reseller country?

questions.question: What is sales amount by order date year?

questions.question: What is sales amount by due date year?

questions.question: What is sales amount by ship date year?

questions.question: Show each territory group's share of total reseller sales.
questions.sql: SELECT t.SalesTerritoryGroup, SUM(f.SalesAmount) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(SalesAmount) FROM dbo.FactResellerSales), 0) AS PctOfTotal FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimSalesTerritory t ON t.SalesTerritoryKey = f.SalesTerritoryKey GROUP BY t.SalesTerritoryGroup ORDER BY t.SalesTerritoryGroup

questions.question: Rank countries by reseller sales.
questions.sql: SELECT t.SalesTerritoryCountry, SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(f.SalesAmount) DESC) AS SalesRank FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimSalesTerritory t ON t.SalesTerritoryKey = f.SalesTerritoryKey GROUP BY t.SalesTerritoryCountry ORDER BY SalesRank, t.SalesTerritoryCountry

questions.question: Show year over year reseller sales with the previous year alongside.
questions.sql: SELECT YEAR(f.OrderDate) AS OrderYear, SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount, LAG(SUM(f.SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.OrderDate)) AS PriorYear FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f GROUP BY YEAR(f.OrderDate) ORDER BY OrderYear

questions.question: Show a running total of reseller sales by year.
questions.sql: SELECT YEAR(f.OrderDate) AS OrderYear, SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount, SUM(SUM(f.SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.OrderDate) ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS RunningTotal FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f GROUP BY YEAR(f.OrderDate) ORDER BY OrderYear

questions.question: Show the average sale amount per order by year.
questions.sql: SELECT v.OrderYear, AVG(v.OrderTotal) AS AvgOrderValue FROM (SELECT YEAR(f.OrderDate) AS OrderYear, f.SalesOrderNumber, SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS OrderTotal FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f GROUP BY YEAR(f.OrderDate), f.SalesOrderNumber) v GROUP BY v.OrderYear ORDER BY v.OrderYear

questions.question: Which resellers ordered in every year from 2011 to 2013?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 20 r.ResellerName FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimReseller r ON r.ResellerKey = f.ResellerKey WHERE YEAR(f.OrderDate) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2013 GROUP BY r.ResellerName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT YEAR(f.OrderDate)) = 3 ORDER BY r.ResellerName

questions.question: Which product lines sold more than one million in total?
questions.sql: SELECT p.ProductLine, SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey GROUP BY p.ProductLine HAVING SUM(f.SalesAmount) > 1000000 ORDER BY p.ProductLine

questions.question: Which countries sold more than 5000 units?
questions.sql: SELECT t.SalesTerritoryCountry, SUM(f.OrderQuantity) AS Units FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimSalesTerritory t ON t.SalesTerritoryKey = f.SalesTerritoryKey GROUP BY t.SalesTerritoryCountry HAVING SUM(f.OrderQuantity) > 5000 ORDER BY t.SalesTerritoryCountry

questions.question: Show margin percentage by product line.
questions.sql: SELECT p.ProductLine, (SUM(f.SalesAmount) - SUM(f.TotalProductCost)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(f.SalesAmount), 0) AS MarginPct FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey GROUP BY p.ProductLine ORDER BY p.ProductLine

questions.question: Show margin percentage by country.
questions.sql: SELECT t.SalesTerritoryCountry, (SUM(f.SalesAmount) - SUM(f.TotalProductCost)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(f.SalesAmount), 0) AS MarginPct FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimSalesTerritory t ON t.SalesTerritoryKey = f.SalesTerritoryKey GROUP BY t.SalesTerritoryCountry ORDER BY t.SalesTerritoryCountry

questions.question: Show the ten product models with the highest average unit price.
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.ModelName, AVG(f.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey WHERE p.ModelName IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.ModelName ORDER BY AVG(f.UnitPrice) DESC, p.ModelName

questions.question: Show total discount given by year.
questions.sql: SELECT YEAR(f.OrderDate) AS OrderYear, SUM(f.DiscountAmount) AS Discount FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f GROUP BY YEAR(f.OrderDate) ORDER BY OrderYear

questions.question: Show freight cost by territory group.
questions.sql: SELECT t.SalesTerritoryGroup, SUM(f.Freight) AS Freight FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimSalesTerritory t ON t.SalesTerritoryKey = f.SalesTerritoryKey GROUP BY t.SalesTerritoryGroup ORDER BY t.SalesTerritoryGroup

questions.question: Show tax collected by country.
questions.sql: SELECT t.SalesTerritoryCountry, SUM(f.TaxAmt) AS Tax FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimSalesTerritory t ON t.SalesTerritoryKey = f.SalesTerritoryKey GROUP BY t.SalesTerritoryCountry ORDER BY t.SalesTerritoryCountry

questions.question: How many distinct products did each territory group sell?
questions.sql: SELECT t.SalesTerritoryGroup, COUNT(DISTINCT f.ProductKey) AS Products FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimSalesTerritory t ON t.SalesTerritoryKey = f.SalesTerritoryKey GROUP BY t.SalesTerritoryGroup ORDER BY t.SalesTerritoryGroup

questions.question: How many resellers ordered in each year?
questions.sql: SELECT YEAR(f.OrderDate) AS OrderYear, COUNT(DISTINCT f.ResellerKey) AS Resellers FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f GROUP BY YEAR(f.OrderDate) ORDER BY OrderYear

questions.question: Show the number of products by class and style.
questions.sql: SELECT Class, Style, COUNT(*) AS Products FROM dbo.DimProduct GROUP BY Class, Style ORDER BY Class, Style

questions.question: Show average days between order and ship date by year.
questions.sql: SELECT YEAR(f.OrderDate) AS OrderYear, AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, f.OrderDate, f.ShipDate) AS float)) AS AvgShipDays FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f WHERE f.ShipDate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY YEAR(f.OrderDate) ORDER BY OrderYear

questions.question: What is the average number of days between order and shipment?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, f.OrderDate, f.ShipDate) AS float)) AS Value FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f WHERE f.ShipDate IS NOT NULL

questions.question: How many reseller sales lines shipped after their due date?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f WHERE f.ShipDate > f.DueDate

questions.question: Summarise shipping performance: total lines, late lines, and late percentage.
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Lines, SUM(CASE WHEN f.ShipDate > f.DueDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LateLines, SUM(CASE WHEN f.ShipDate > f.DueDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS LatePct FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f

questions.question: What is the overall discount picture: total discount, discounted lines, and average discount?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(f.DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscount, SUM(CASE WHEN f.DiscountAmount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DiscountedLines, AVG(f.DiscountAmount) AS AvgDiscount FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f

questions.question: Give the product catalogue summary: total, finished goods, and with a list price.
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Products, SUM(CASE WHEN FinishedGoodsFlag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FinishedGoods, SUM(CASE WHEN ListPrice IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WithListPrice FROM dbo.DimProduct

questions.question: Summarise the reseller base: total, with sales, and without.
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Resellers, SUM(v.HasSales) AS WithSales, SUM(1 - v.HasSales) AS WithoutSales FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f WHERE f.ResellerKey = r.ResellerKey) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HasSales FROM dbo.DimReseller r) v

questions.question: Show the first and last order year for the ten busiest resellers.
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 10 r.ResellerName, MIN(f.OrderDate) AS FirstOrder, MAX(f.OrderDate) AS LastOrder, COUNT(*) AS Lines FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimReseller r ON r.ResellerKey = f.ResellerKey GROUP BY r.ResellerName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, r.ResellerName

questions.question: Show sales by product line and year.
questions.sql: SELECT p.ProductLine, YEAR(f.OrderDate) AS OrderYear, SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey GROUP BY p.ProductLine, YEAR(f.OrderDate) ORDER BY p.ProductLine, OrderYear

questions.question: Show units sold by product colour and year.
questions.sql: SELECT p.Color, YEAR(f.OrderDate) AS OrderYear, SUM(f.OrderQuantity) AS Units FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey GROUP BY p.Color, YEAR(f.OrderDate) ORDER BY p.Color, OrderYear

questions.question: Which ten products had the widest gap between list price and standard cost?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 10 EnglishProductName, ListPrice, StandardCost, ListPrice - StandardCost AS Markup FROM dbo.DimProduct WHERE ListPrice IS NOT NULL AND StandardCost IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ListPrice - StandardCost DESC, EnglishProductName

questions.question: Show reseller counts by product line they carry.
questions.sql: SELECT ProductLine, COUNT(*) AS Resellers FROM dbo.DimReseller GROUP BY ProductLine ORDER BY ProductLine

questions.question: Show the number of customers by number of cars owned.
questions.sql: SELECT NumberCarsOwned, COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM dbo.DimCustomer GROUP BY NumberCarsOwned ORDER BY NumberCarsOwned
